description: Single source of truth for pathway activation arithmetic, severity bands, and recovery-influence flow. Engines must not reimplement these formulas.

activationModel.formula: activation(p) = clip[0,1]( gateMultiplier(p) * ( sum_i (w_supports_i * conf_i) - sum_j (|w_inhibits_j| * conf_j) ) )

gateMultiplier.description: Pathway activation is gated by required-signals. If pathway declares >=1 required-gate signals, at least one must be present at confidence >= gateMinConfidence, OR sum of present required-gate signal contributions must exceed gateMinAggregate. Otherwise activation is forced to 0.
gateMultiplier.noGateBehavior: If a pathway declares zero required-gate signals (modulator pathway), gateMultiplier = 1.0 unconditionally — used for oxidative-stress and similar.

activationModel.weightedLinearRationale: Pathway activation answers 'how much process is happening'. Weighted-sum-with-cap is correct because contributions are additive (more evidence → higher activation) and inhibitors must subtract symmetrically. Noisy-OR is reserved for signal-level confidence aggregation where multiple rules fire for the same observation.

steps.name: Inherit Signals
steps.operation: For each signal s referenced by pathway p, read s.confidence (post Signal Registry aggregation).

steps.name: Gate Check
steps.operation: If p.requiredGate non-empty: gateMultiplier = 1.0 if any required-gate signal at conf >= gateMinConfidence OR sum of required-gate signal confidences >= gateMinAggregate; else 0.0.

steps.name: Supporting Sum
steps.operation: support = sum over supportingSignals of (weight_i * confidence_i).

steps.name: Inhibitory Sum
steps.operation: inhibit = sum over inhibitorySignals of (|weight_j| * confidence_j).

steps.name: Interaction Adjustment
steps.operation: For each interaction edge (otherPathway, type, magnitude) where type == 'amplifies' and otherPathway.activation >= interactionThreshold: raw += magnitude * otherPathway.activation. Cap total amplification per pathway at interactionAmplificationCap.

activationModel.determinism: Steps must be applied in two passes: pass 1 computes raw activations for all pathways with interaction adjustment skipped; pass 2 applies interaction adjustment using pass-1 results. Two-pass evaluation makes the operation order-independent and convergent without iteration.

confidenceModel.description: Pathway confidence is DISTINCT from pathway activation. Activation = 'how much is this process happening'. Confidence = 'how sure are we'. Used by Cause Ranker to weight pathway evidence and by Explainability for trustworthiness.

components.evidenceMass: Sum over present supporting + required-gate signals of (weight * confidence * evidenceTierWeight)
components.uncertaintyMass: Sum over absent expected signals of (weight * absenceCost) + count of conflicting present signals * conflictCost
components.tierFloorWeight: Worst evidence tier among present required-gate or top-3 supporting signals → established=1.00, emerging=0.85, heuristic=0.65

severityModel.description: Severity quantifies clinical gravity, not activation magnitude. A fully-active fully-reversible pathway has lower severity than a half-active stabilizable one.
severityModel.formula: severity(p) = activation(p) * reversibilityWeight(p) * sum_i (signal_i.severityContribution * signal_i.confidence) / normalizationFactor

recoveryImpactModel.description: Per-pathway contribution to RecoveryProfile (Clinical Phase 4). The Recovery Engine sums these across all activated pathways, then applies modifiers from demographics and lifestyle separately.
recoveryImpactModel.scalingByActivation: Each declared delta in registry.json is the MAX magnitude at activation = 1.0. Effective delta = declaredDelta * activation(p).

subthresholdHandling.description: Pathways with activation < minimumActivationThreshold are still emitted as nodes in PathwayGraph (for explainability transparency) but DO NOT contribute to Cause ranking, Recovery, or Objectives.
subthresholdHandling.label: dormant

governanceConstraints: All weights in registry.json must be in [-1.0, 1.0]. Supports must be positive, inhibits negative, required-gates positive.

Sum of supporting weights for a pathway must be in [0.5, 10.0] — registry CI rejects pathways with no upside coverage or with excessive cumulative weight. Upper bound accommodates pathways with many overlapping precipitant signals (e.g. telogen-cycle-disruption); activation is always clipped to [0,1].
A pathway with reversibilityClass == 'shaft-only-reversible' may only declare hair-shaft-damage-related objectives in treatmentImplications.
Interaction edges must be symmetric only when type == 'competes'. 'amplifies' and 'mediates' may be unidirectional.
Any change to formulas, constants, or steps requires major version bump + full parity fixture regeneration.
